answers.explanation: Sendmail, from 1983. Postfix was written later as a safer replacement.
Exchange is a groupware server, not just an MTA.
Postfix moves mail. A separate server, usually Dovecot, handles mailboxes, IMAP, and POP.
sendmail.mc, processed with m4 into sendmail.cf.
A smart host, set with SMART_HOST in sendmail.mc.
It re-directs ingress mail: accept it, then hand it to another IP for final delivery.
The relay faces the Internet, filters, and forwards clean mail inward.
Exchange Online Protection receives the mail, filters it, and delivers it to the mailboxes.
If your server's IP lands on a blocklist, other servers refuse your mail.
